reviews.title: Current info only for US and UK waters
reviews.text: This was not mentioned in the description unfortunately.

reviews.title: Latest Update Cumbersome
reviews.text: Used to be able to easily scroll to see tides for the week. Now it feels cumbersome where it used to be easy. Too many clicks in too many different spots to get information. Also, the app should reset to the Home page once it was closed out instead it stays at the last page visited.

reviews.title: App now charging
reviews.text: I will be deleting the app after I close this review. I will not be charged to see what tide it is tomorrow. There’s plenty of alternatives for free - the council website for one!

reviews.title: v4 now adware :(
reviews.text:
I see you slipped an "update to premium" banner and a threat of ads quietly into the release without mentioning it in the notes.

Kinda sneaky, I liked the app, have used it for a few years and would've donated a few more quid if you'd asked.

reviews.title: Does not give necessary information
